privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.tldr: We only collect what you send us (like your contact-form details) and basic technical data. We never sell your personal data, we keep it only as long as we need it, and you can ask us to access or delete it anytime at support@oraixen.com.

sections.heading: Introduction & Who We Are
sections.body: Oraixen ("we", "our", or "us") is a software studio headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, with a delivery team across Egypt and the wider MENA region. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle personal data we collect through oraixen.com and when you contact us. For the purposes of applicable data-protection law, Oraixen is the data controller. Questions about this policy can be sent to support@oraixen.com.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: (a) Information you give us — through our contact form: your name, email, company, budget range, project timeline, and message, plus anything else you choose to email us. (b) Information collected automatically — your IP address, browser and device type, the pages you view, and your approximate location, gathered through standard server logs and analytics. We do not intentionally collect sensitive categories of personal data.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to respond to and scope your inquiry, to provide and improve our services and website, to communicate with you about your request, to maintain the security of our systems, and to meet our legal obligations. We send marketing communications only where permitted, and you can opt out at any time. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Legal Basis for Processing
sections.body: Where EU, EEA, or UK law applies, we process personal data on one or more of the following legal bases: your consent, our legitimate interests, the performance of a contract, or compliance with a legal obligation. [Placeholder — bases to be confirmed by counsel.]

sections.heading: Cookies & Analytics
sections.body: We use essential cookies to run the site and analytics cookies to understand how it is used. You can manage or disable cookies in your browser settings. Where required, a consent banner lets you accept or reject non-essential cookies. [Placeholder — specific providers to be listed once confirmed.]

sections.heading: How We Share Your Information
sections.body: We share your information only with vetted service providers and processors — for hosting, email, analytics, and form handling — under confidentiality and data-processing terms, or where we are required to do so by law. We do not sell or rent your personal data.

sections.heading: International Data Transfers
sections.body: Your data may be processed in Canada, in Egypt and the MENA region, or by our international service providers. Where required by law, we apply appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers, such as Standard Contractual Clauses. [Placeholder — transfer mechanism to be confirmed by counsel.]

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We keep your personal data only as long as needed for the purpose it was collected for, and to satisfy legal and accounting requirements. When it is no longer needed, we delete or anonymize it. [Placeholder — specific retention periods to be set with counsel.]

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including access controls, encryption in transit, code reviews, and a secure development lifecycle. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live (for example under GDPR or PIPEDA), you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent. To exercise these rights, email support@oraixen.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your local authority — in Canada, the Office of the Privacy Commissioner.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our website is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If we learn that we have collected such data, we will delete it.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date above reflects the latest version, and we will highlight any material changes.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, contact us at: Oraixen, support@oraixen.com, +1-313-482-0813, Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.tldr: Use our site fairly, our website content is ours, and any project we build for you is governed by the specific written agreement we sign with you — including who owns the code, what's covered, and how payment works.

sections.heading: Acceptance of These Terms
sections.body: By accessing oraixen.com or using our services, you agree to these Terms of Service. They govern your use of our website. Specific projects are also governed by a separate signed agreement, as described in the sections on Our Services and Intellectual Property below.

sections.heading: Our Services
sections.body: We provide software development, web development, corporate-platform engineering, and hardware-plus-AI solutions. The exact scope, deliverables, timeline, and price of any engagement are defined in a separate signed proposal or contract. We may update or discontinue features of this website at any time.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property & Ownership of Deliverables
sections.body: (a) On full payment, the client owns the final custom code and deliverables, with full intellectual-property transfer as set out in the signed agreement. (b) Our pre-existing tools, frameworks, and reusable components remain ours, and are licensed to you as needed. (c) The content of this website — including our name, logo, text, designs, and code — is owned by Oraixen.

sections.heading: Payment Terms
sections.body: Fees, milestones, invoicing schedules, and payment methods are set out in each signed agreement. Invoices are due on the agreed dates, and late payments may pause ongoing work. [Placeholder — late-fee and currency terms to be confirmed by counsel.]

sections.heading: Client Responsibilities
sections.body: You agree to provide timely information, approvals, content, and access, and to ensure you hold the rights to any materials you supply to us. Delays in client input may shift project timelines accordingly.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: Each party agrees to keep the other's confidential information private. We are happy to sign a non-disclosure agreement before detailed discussions, and we can keep client names and project details confidential on request.

sections.heading: Warranties & Disclaimers
sections.body: We perform our services with professional skill and care, supported by a documented QA process. Project-specific warranties — such as a post-launch support window — are defined in the signed agreement. Otherwise, this website is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind, and we do not promise that it will be error-free or uninterrupted.

sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Our total liability is limited as set out in the signed agreement, or, absent one, to the amounts you paid us for the relevant service. [Placeholder — liability cap to be set by counsel.]

sections.heading: Third-Party Links & Services
sections.body: We do not control, and are not responsible for, third-party tools, links, or services referenced on our website. Your use of them is at your own risk and subject to their terms.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate access to the website for misuse. Project engagements end in line with the signed agreement; surviving sections — such as intellectual property, confidentiality, and payment for work already done — continue to apply.
